A. Merritt, The Moon Pool.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/a-merritt/the-moon-pool

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- A. Merritt, author, died 1943 (Wikidata Q330376, death 1943-08-21).

First publication of the text used: 1918, in the United States: serialized in Argosy All-Story Weekly, the issue of June 22, 1918 (Wikipedia, The Moon Pool). SE colophon: 'The Moon Pool was published in 1919 by A. Merritt.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1918, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States and the text was first published there before 1931, so the US rule settles the origin too, whatever Merritt's death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
